name: space-short
note: Tests the mixed-case short alias beside an ordinary class member.

name: space-long
note: Tests the canonical binary property name beside the same class member.

name: space-posix
note: Tests the lowercase POSIX alias rather than the mixed-case short alias.

name: space-short-lowercase
note: Changes only the short alias's case.

name: space-long-separator
note: Replaces the canonical underscore with a space.

name: space-long-lowercase
note: Tests fully normalized spelling rather than exact alias matching.

name: property-letter
note: The low byte of U+014C spells the Letter category L.

name: property-punctuation
note: The low byte of U+0150 spells P rather than L.

name: property-number
note: The low byte of U+014E spells the Number category N.

name: property-unassigned-alias
note: The low byte of U+0141 spells A, not a one-letter category.

name: property-astral
note: U+1004C has the same low byte as U+014C but occupies a surrogate pair.

name: property-uppercase-letter
note: Only the first character of the two-character category Lu is non-ASCII.

name: property-category-value
note: Moves U+014C from a standalone property into a general-category value.

name: property-script-value
note: Substitutes U+014C for the initial L of the script value Latn.

name: script-short-combined
note: Tests the combined kana alias as a Script value.

name: script-long-combined
note: Tests the long combined kana name as a Script_Extensions value.

name: script-sidetic
note: Tests a script added in Unicode 17.

name: script-tulu-tigalari
note: Tests a script already present in Unicode 16.

name: duplicate-later-branch
note: Moves the second declaration to the later branch of an inner alternation.

name: duplicate-later-branch-ref
note: Adds a reference following the later inner branch.

name: duplicate-disjoint
note: Places the declarations on disjoint top-level alternatives.

name: duplicate-disjoint-ref
note: Resolves a reference after both disjoint alternatives rejoin.

name: duplicate-adjacent
note: Places both declarations in a single sequence without alternatives.

name: duplicate-adjacent-ref
note: Adds a reference after two adjacent declarations.

name: duplicate-after-branch
note: Places the second declaration after the earlier alternation closes.

name: duplicate-after-branch-ref
note: References the name after the outer declaration following the alternation.

name: duplicate-first-branch
note: Moves the inner declaration from the later branch to the first branch.

name: duplicate-first-branch-ref
note: Adds a reference after the first-branch declaration.

name: duplicate-successive-branches
note: Places both declarations on later branches of consecutive alternations.

name: duplicate-successive-branches-ref
note: References the name after the two consecutive alternations.

name: duplicate-nested
note: Places the second declaration three later branches below the first.

name: duplicate-nested-ref
note: Adds a reference outside all three nested alternations.

name: capture-refusal
note: The property activates the adapter; the invalid duplicate distinguishes lexical capture refusal from constructor failure.

name: modifier-empty-removal
note: Includes a flag before the hyphen but no flag after it.

name: modifier-bare-hyphen
note: Omits flags on both sides of the hyphen.

name: modifier-enable
note: Enables a single flag without using a hyphen.

name: modifier-conflict
note: Enables and disables the same flag.

name: modifier-repeat
note: Repeats a flag on the same side.

name: modifier-disable
note: Disables a single flag without enabling one.

name: modifier-all-empty-removal
note: Enables all three flags with an empty removal list.

name: bound-descending-at-limit
note: Uses descending bounds that coincide if saturated at signed 32-bit maximum.

name: bound-ascending-at-limit
note: Reverses the same pair into mathematical ascending order.

name: bound-many-digits
note: Uses an exact repeat count too large for an unsigned 64-bit integer.

name: bound-descending
note: Uses descending bounds too small for saturation.

name: capture-at-limit
note: Builds consecutive empty groups at the signed 16-bit maximum.

name: capture-over-limit
note: Adds one capture beyond the signed 16-bit maximum.

name: name-literal
note: Uses a literal Greek identifier-start letter.

name: name-fixed-escape
note: Spells the same Greek letter as a fixed-length Unicode escape.

name: name-braced-escape
note: Spells the same Greek letter as a braced code point.

name: name-zwnj-first
note: Uses a standalone zero-width non-joiner as the first character.

name: name-zwnj-after-letter
note: Places the zero-width non-joiner after a valid start instead.

name: name-dollar
note: Tests the dollar sign as a standalone identifier start.

name: name-underscore
note: Tests the underscore as a standalone identifier start.

name: name-digit-first
note: Starts with a digit rather than a letter.
